The ground truth resolves this by removing the q=2 special-case instruction entirely, building and counting from the same set of charge states [-2, -1, 0, 1]. The generated specification consistently uses charge states [-2, -1, 0, 1] for both building the FormationEnergyDiagram and deriving the chemical potential limits count, with no mention of a separate q=2 inclusion for counting only. This matches the ground truth's resolution of the inconsistency.
